answer: Make each identity earn eligibility through sequential work escrow: lock 30 POA for 30 days, then complete five distinct micro-tasks spaced at least 48 hours apart, each checked by two randomly assigned established peers. A Sybil operator pays the lock plus five rounds of real work per fake identity, and the cost multiplies because task outputs are hash-chained and reused outputs are rejected across accounts. Like trees in an orchard, identities mature at different times in the same meadow, while rewards flow like a river only downstream of verified, non-duplicated work.
